heroHeadline: Magyar Meets Von der Leyen; Cabinet Named; May 9 Inauguration in 5 Days
heroSubtitle: Péter Magyar held his first EU Commission talks in Brussels on April 29, targeting a late-May political deal to unlock €17B in frozen funds; full 16-member cabinet announced May 2, with Anita Orbán as Foreign Minister. Parliament's inaugural session — and Magyar's swearing-in as PM — is set for May 9, Europe Day.
footerNote: Tracker covers Hungary's political transition from Orbán's 2010 return to power through the 2026 post-election transition. Data reflects publicly available reports from verified sources.
